content.short: XDC Network is a hybrid blockchain for enterprises.
content.description: XDC Network is an open-source blockchain designed for enterprises, offering an EVM-compatible environment that enables developers to deploy smart contracts and interact with the existing Ethereum toolchain. Built with a focus on business use cases, it supports tokenizing real-world assets and financial instruments, aiming to streamline workflows, improve interoperability, and unlock new finance models. By combining enterprise-ready features with open collaboration, XDC Network provides a foundation for scalable, transparent digital asset ecosystems.
